$comment: Encompassing edges: `topicId` implicitly practises `encompassedId` when you work on it. `coverage` (0–1) is the fraction of the simpler topic that the advanced one actually exercises. These edges power Fractional Implicit Repetition — a review of the advanced topic pays discounted repetition credit down to everything it encompasses — and Spaced Repetition Compression, which picks the smallest set of reviews that covers everything due. Encompassed topics are usually prerequisites; prerequisites are often not fully encompassed.
